title: BnF MEZANNO Quadrennial Project
summary: Open platform for social sciences and humanities researchers to define corpora, annotate them semi-automatically through remote APIs, and export interoperable structured data from IIIF sources.
role: Coordinator for EPITA (team coordination, event organization, development management)
fundingSources: BnF MEZANNO quadrennial project with IGN, EHESS, and BnF

title: ANR SODUCO Project
summary: Chronological mapping of socio-economic activities in Paris (1789-1950), combining extraction from historical directories and maps with geohistorical data linking at large scale.
role: Coordinator for EPITA; co-supervision and document analysis contributions
fundingSources: ANR project with IGN, EHESS, National Archives, and BnF

title: NER for Historical Documents Group
summary: Collaborative research group dedicated to text analysis from noisy OCR in historical documents, with a focus on named entity recognition and robust evaluation setups.

title: ICDAR MapText Competitions
summary: International shared tasks for historical map text detection, recognition, and linking, including benchmark design, dataset curation, and community-driven evaluation material.
role: International competition coordination and scientific steering

title: Mobile Document Capture and OCR Challenges
summary: Research and transfer activities on smartphone document acquisition, quality assessment, and robust OCR workflows, including public competitions and open evaluation frameworks.

title: NUMIS - Indexing Images of Ancient Coins
summary: Research and transfer work on segmentation and indexing of numismatic document imagery in the FEDER NUMIS context, including evaluation-oriented workflows for grayscale coin documents.

title: Contextual and Assisted Interpretation of Historical Archives
summary: PhD-era project on semi-automatic analysis of difficult 18th-century archival collections, conducted with the Departmental Archives of Yvelines and focused on interactive, collection-aware document understanding.

title: BrainLes / MICCAI MRI Tumor Challenges
summary: Participation in MRI brain lesion segmentation and survival prediction challenges, with lightweight and reproducible deep-learning pipelines.
